mentions.name: WindowInk
mentions.description: WindowInk is a simple digital signage system that works without subscriptions, running on low-cost devices such as Raspberry Pi (ideal configuration on Pi 5). It simplifies updating signage displays with images and videos.
mentions.problem: Updating signage based on images and videos was challenging and typically required subscriptions; rising memory prices have also made the low-cost devices it relies on more expensive.
mentions.source_excerpt: Simple digital signage without subscriptions. The goal was to help reduce some of the challenges with updating signage based on images and videos using low cost devices.

evidence.value: Simple digital signage without subscriptions. The goal was to help reduce some of the challenges with updating signage based on images and videos using low cost devices.
